title: Homemade Candied Pecans
creator: Happy Healing Tx- Kendall Mitchell
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F and line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
Whisk the egg whites and water until frothy, then stir in the vanilla.
In a separate bowl, mix the sugar, cinnamon, and salt.
Toss the pecans in the egg mixture, then coat evenly with the cinnamon sugar mixture.
Spread evenly onto the baking sheets in a single layer.
Bake for 25–30 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the coating is set and the pecans are toasted.
Let cool completely so they get perfectly crisp.
notes: From a Happy Healing Tx (Kendall Mitchell) Facebook Reel; full recipe from the caption. Instagram @happyhealingtx. Commenters suggest optional cayenne, Ziploc tossing, crockpot, or other nuts — not creator instructions.
